rows.grounds: relative pronoun instrumental feminine singular referring to the supreme goddess
passive present third singular from root dhṛ
adjective neuter accusative singular agreeing with idam
compound of brahmāṇḍa (cosmic egg) and parimaṇḍala (sphere/circumference)

items.question: By whose power is the whole brahmanda sphere upheld?
premises: The supreme goddess is worshipped there.
By her the cosmic sphere is held.
items.inference: The verse presents the supreme goddess as the support of the entire cosmic sphere.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yayā depends on the preceding context.
brahmāṇḍaparimaṇḍalam may denote sphere or circumference.
items.plain_english: By her, this entire cosmic sphere is held.
